cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.30)
project(darkmetal)

# generated by Conan
if (IS_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/generators)
    set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH ${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/generators)
endif()

# Most of these static libraries have the least dependencies on other modules, and
# with some refactoring they can become even more self-contained
# More importantly, lhnet needs to be fully independent for future online lobby work.

# If we bump the C library version then we can just have a thin wrapper around C11 threads (or use them directly)
# instead of these various wrappers around different backends
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-system-shared STATIC 
                        src/sys_shared.c
                        src/vid_shared.c                        
                        src/snd_wav.c
                        src/snd_ogg.c
                        src/snd_mem.c
                        src/snd_mix.c)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-system-win32 EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL STATIC 
                        src/thread_win.c
                        src/vid_wgl.c
                        src/snd_win.c
                        src/sys_win.c)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-system-linux EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL STATIC 
                        src/thread_pthread.c
                        src/vid_glx.c
                        src/snd_coreaudio.c
                        src/sys_linux.c)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-system-mac EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL STATIC 
                        src/thread_pthread.c
                        src/vid_agl.c
                        src/snd_coreaudio.c
                        src/sys_unix.c)

find_package(SDL2)

if(SDL2_FOUND)
	add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-system-sdl EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL STATIC 
							src/thread_sdl.c
							src/vid_sdl.c
							src/snd_sdl.c
							src/sys_sdl.c)
							
    target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME}-system-sdl PRIVATE ${PROJECT_NAME}-system-shared SDL2::SDL2main)							
endif()


foreach(SYS_TARGET IN ITEMS ${PROJECT_NAME}-system-win32 
                            ${PROJECT_NAME}-system-linux 
                            ${PROJECT_NAME}-system-mac)
    target_link_libraries(${SYS_TARGET} PRIVATE ${PROJECT_NAME}-system-shared)
endforeach()


if(SDL2_FOUND)
	add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-system ALIAS ${PROJECT_NAME}-system-sdl) 
elseif (WIN32)
	add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-system ALIAS ${PROJECT_NAME}-system-win32) 
# TODO add check for SDL package
# TODO add check for UNIX based OSs for pthreads
#else()
endif()

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-lhnet STATIC src/lhnet.c)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-math STATIC 
        src/mathlib.c
        src/matrixlib.c
        src/fractalnoise.c
        src/curves.c)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-renderer-software STATIC src/dpsoftrast.c)

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} WIN32 
        src/sv_move.c
        src/sv_main.c
        src/sv_phys.c
        src/sv_user.c
        src/sv_demo.c
        src/svvm_cmds.c
        src/cl_main.c
        src/cl_video.c
        src/cl_demo.c
        src/cl_input.c
        src/cl_parse.c
        src/cl_particles.c
        src/cl_collision.c
        src/cl_dyntexture.c
        src/cl_video.c
        src/cl_screen.c
        src/snd_main.c 
        src/clvm_cmds.c
        src/gl_textures.c
        src/gl_draw.c
        src/gl_rsurf.c
        src/gl_rmain.c
        src/gl_backend.c
        src/console.c
        src/r_lightning.c
        src/r_shadow.c
        src/r_modules.c
        src/r_sprites.c
        src/r_sky.c
        src/r_explosion.c
        src/polygon.c
        src/ft2.c
        src/bih.c        
        src/meshqueue.c
        src/model_shared.c
        src/model_sprite.c
        src/model_alias.c
        src/model_brush.c
        src/mod_skeletal_animatevertices_sse.c
        src/mod_skeletal_animatevertices_generic.c        
        src/cl_parse.c
        src/csprogs.c
        src/dpvsimpledecode.c
        src/builddate.c
        src/view.c
        src/sbar.c
        src/host_cmd.c
        src/libcurl.c
        src/collision.c  
        src/protocol.c 
        src/netconn.c 
        src/cap_ogg.c
        src/svbsp.c
        src/palette.c
        src/world.c
        src/portals.c
        src/keys.c 
        src/host.c
        src/prvm_exec.c
        src/prvm_cmds.c
        src/prvm_edict.c
        src/common.c
        src/thread_win.c
        src/zone.c
        src/image.c
        src/image_png.c
        src/utf8lib.c
        src/fs.c
        src/cmd.c
        src/cvar.c
        src/filematch.c
        src/zone.c
        src/wad.c
        src/mdfour.c
        src/jpeg.c
        src/hmac.c
        src/crypto.c
)

set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES ENABLE_EXPORTS ON)

target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE 
        ${PROJECT_NAME}-math        
        ${PROJECT_NAME}-lhnet
        ${PROJECT_NAME}-system
        ${PROJECT_NAME}-renderer-software)
